title: Tokenizer Training
seoDescription: Build a subword vocabulary by iteratively merging the most frequent adjacent token pair.
description:
Identify most frequent adjacent symbol pair across vocabulary corpus and execute merge operation.

BPE iteratively compresses common character sequences into single tokens, resolving out-of-vocabulary challenges while bounding total dictionary size.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
(s_1^*, s_2^*) = \arg\max_{(s_1, s_2)} \sum_{w} \text{freq}(w) \cdot \text{count}((s_1, s_2), w)
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Count frequencies of all adjacent token pairs weighted by word frequencies
2. Select pair with maximum occurrence count
3. Merge occurrences of optimal pair in vocabulary words

### Returns
Dictionary with 'best_pair', 'count', and updated 'merged_corpus'.
